text: why does it have a whole recovery phase. it shouldnt do that. it should just roll over and the player has to get out and find a new car if it doesnt roll itself and eventually would catch on fire and blow up
resolution: Dropped the self-righting recovery phase I'd added in req_0709 — a rolled car should stay rolled, not flop itself back upright. In game/driving/index.ts the flipped branch is now just the bistable tumble: the committed kick + light damping (0.12) still carry the car fully over the on-its-side peak so it genuinely rolls (no half-lean flicker), then gravity settles it roof-down and it STAYS there. It only returns to drivable if its own momentum happens to carry it all the way back onto its wheels — never forced. Verified by sim: after a 2s hard turn then input release + 6s coast, sedan and van rest inverted with flipped=true (~170°, on the roof); sports/fire_truck never trip (slide instead). handling.test.ts 7/7 green. Lab banner updated to 'ROLLED OVER — reset for a new car (R to right)' — reset stands in for getting out and finding a new car, R is a manual right for handling testing. The 'totaled car eventually catches fire and blows up' behavior is noted as a follow-up feature, not implemented here.
